classification: TOOL_FAILURE: Git LFS filter auto-install side effect
remedy: Remove only these four task-created files after all transport completed; preserve the directory and original repository hooks. Subsequent restore used no filters/checkout and the new hook directory stayed empty.
known_pre_push_effect: LFS checked the already uploaded 67 objects again at 0 B/s during the first normal Git push.
correction: The initially empty task hook directory was populated by Git LFS 3.4 filters and later used; whole-session hook disablement is not a verified claim.
